entries.subject: payshap_system_transaction_ceiling
entries.display: R50,000 PayShap ceiling per transaction (from October 2024)
entries.quote: In August 2024, PayInc announced a mandatory increase in the PayShap transaction limit from R3,000 to R50,000, effective October 2024. Individual banks may set their own limits up to this ceiling.
entries.notes: Corroborated by GoTyme's page referring to 'the R50,000 limit'.

entries.subject: payshap_limit_set_by_bank
entries.display: Each participating bank sets its own PayShap limit up to the R50,000 ceiling
entries.quote: Individual banks may set their own limits up to this ceiling.
entries.notes: Nedbank applies R5,000/day while GoTyme allows up to R50,000, which evidences bank-specific limits.

entries.subject: nedbank_payshap_daily_limit
entries.display: R5,000 per day sending and receiving PayShap at Nedbank
entries.quote: You can instantly send and receive a PayShap payment of up to R5,000 a day at participating banks.
entries.notes: Bank help page, undated; captured 2026-11-02. Source page undated; effective date recorded as the 2026-11-02 capture date.

entries.subject: gotyme_standard_payment_limit
entries.display: R500,000 per Standard Payment (non-instant EFT) at GoTyme Bank
entries.quote: Use a Standard Payment instead. It is always free with us and handles up to R500,000.

entries.subject: rtc_single_transaction_limit_before_16h00
entries.display: RTC payments limited to under R5 million up to 16:00
entries.quote: RTC urgent payments can be used where the transaction value is below R5 million (five million Rand) up and to 16h00, from 16h01 to 19h00 the transaction value falls to R250,000.00
entries.notes: Standard Bank operational regulations v4.5, document code 00164409 (2017-07).

entries.subject: rtc_single_transaction_limit_16h01_19h00
entries.display: RTC payments limited to R250,000 between 16:01 and 19:00
entries.quote: RTC urgent payments can be used where the transaction value is below R5 million (five million Rand) up and to 16h00, from 16h01 to 19h00 the transaction value falls to R250,000.00

entries.subject: rtgs_threshold
entries.display: Payments above R5 million cannot be split and must go via RTGS
entries.quote: Payment instructions that exceed R5 000 000-00 (five million rands) (in respect of the same underlying commercial transaction) cannot be split by a Client and must be processed via RTGS.

entries.subject: capitec_app_send_cash_limit_per_transaction
entries.display: R3,000 per transaction sending cash on the Capitec app
entries.quote: Remote banking app limits for sending cash: R3 000 per transaction, R5 000 per day, R24 990 per month

entries.subject: capitec_app_send_cash_limit_per_day
entries.display: R5,000 per day sending cash on the Capitec app
entries.quote: Remote banking app limits for sending cash: R3 000 per transaction, R5 000 per day, R24 990 per month

entries.subject: capitec_send_cash_monthly_limit
entries.display: R24,990 per month sending cash (app and USSD)
entries.quote: Remote banking app limits for sending cash: R3 000 per transaction, R5 000 per day, R24 990 per month
entries.notes: Capitec fee schedule note 10; the same monthly cap applies on USSD per note 11.

entries.subject: capitec_ussd_send_cash_limit_per_transaction
entries.display: R1,000 per transaction sending cash via USSD *120*3279#
entries.quote: Mobile banking (\*120\*3279#) limits for sending cash: R1 000 per transaction, R1 000 per day, R24 990 per month

notes: Limits are scheme-level (PayShap ceiling, RTC/RTGS thresholds) and bank-level (Nedbank, GoTyme, Capitec). PayShap limits differ by bank, so both the R50,000 ceiling and Nedbank's R5,000/day are recorded separately.
